qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Contractual monopoly as exclusive Attorney-in-Fact for Erie Insurance Exchange subscribers, taking an ad-valorem management fee of up to 25% (set at 25%) of direct written premiums. Deeply entrenched independent agency network (~13,000 agents) and high policyholder retention (>90%). 10-year median ROIC of 29.2% with zero debt. Premium rate hikes flow mechanically into revenue without underwriting capital outlay. Primary erosion risk is regulatory or Exchange board pressure to lower the 25% fee cap if Exchange underwriting surplus faces severe catastrophe stress.
qualitative.note: Passes all 6 gates. Asset-light, zero-debt toll booth collecting a 25% top-line management fee on Erie Insurance Exchange premiums without underwriting risk. Automatic pass-through of P&C rate inflation. Fortress balance sheet with zero long-term debt and ~100% FCF conversion. [5-10Y g: policy/exposure growth 2.5% + P&C premium rate inflation 4.0% + operating leverage 0.5% + dividend reinvestment/buyback 0.5%]
qualitative.evidence: 10-year GAAP ROIC consistently 21–35% (median 29.2%). Multi-year Owner FCF conversion averages ~99.5%. Long-term debt is $0.0M against $345.9M cash and $717.2M EBIT. Underwriting risk is legally segregated at the Exchange, shielding Indemnity from underwriting losses while allowing it to capture top-line fee growth from rising premium volumes.
